question: Does the registered CText 《授時曆故》 digital citation actually attest 八百二十 at its displayed 損益捷法 locus, and may a conflicting digitized transcription be treated as a historical source variant?

readings.source: CText 《授時曆故》 民國嘉業堂本 digital OCR/received transcription
readings.locus: 求遲疾差; adjacent 率法/損益捷法 and 遲疾日率 passages
readings.observed_web_search_text: 置損益分以日率八百一十分而一
readings.other_local_observation: 同一公開文字還在附近顯示 八百一十分, and visibly garbled characters such as 麻/慨/雌/酬; exact 810 cannot be upgraded to historical original.

readings.source: 識典古籍《授時曆故》黃宗羲, page-level received text
readings.locus: 置損益分...損益捷法; 求遲疾厤限...日率
readings.observed_text: 置損益分以日率八百二十分而一; 置所得限以日率八百二十分○八秒乘之

readings.source: Earlier directly reviewed Xing Yunlu Ming-format Juan45 end original
readings.observation: 右置八百二十以遲行度而一為捷法

provenance_correction: The pre-existing root source registry note for EXT-CTEXT-SHOUSHI-LIGU-JIAYETANG describes the explanatory source using 820, but the now-retrieved CText OCR search passage visibly says 810. This forward-only exception records the mismatch rather than silently rewriting that historical registry note, treating OCR output as antique evidence, or assuming the Shidian transcription shares a particular physical copy with CText.
mechanical_scope: Huang's later 損益分÷日率 捷法 and Xing's 遲行度 inverse 820÷rate are not the same operation merely because both use a displayed 820; neither supplies an original 疾-specific 1599/1600 constructor or native 微 radix/carry.
unresolved: Obtain a physical original or high-resolution source-native facsimile of the precise Huang 《授時曆故》 locus to adjudicate whether 810 is simply OCR corruption.
An original Huang line would still be a later retrospective explanatory witness, not independent early Xu-An L132 or original G893 six-control evidence.
Prioritize early independent Xu-An juan45 L132 and authentic premodern 疾 constructor; do not use either later webpage to fill the unread 二/三.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Differences between two digital transcriptions are not an authenticated edition/print variation, and agreeing 820 strings in distinct operations do not prove a shared historical constructor.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Which original printed Huang witness underlies each text and does its native glyph read 二 or 一 at the 820/810 locus?

next_action: Do not treat CText 810 as an ancient independent source variant. Keep P0 focused on authenticated independently legible Xu-An L132 and source-original 疾-specific constructor/precision.
